title: Unhandled application exceptions (HTTP 500)

steps.title: Collect stack traces for the failing requests
steps.description: Use the request_ids from the incident to find full exception traces in application logs or APM.

steps.title: Check for a recent deployment or configuration change
steps.description: Compare the incident start time with the deployment and config-change history of the service.

steps.title: Check downstream dependencies
steps.description: Verify that the databases and services this endpoint calls are healthy.

steps.title: Roll back the most recent deployment
steps.description: If a release lines up with the first error, roll back to the previous version.

escalation: Owning team on-call; release manager if a rollback is considered.
